    <section class="page" id="method">
      <div class="hero"><div><h1>Data & Methodology</h1><p>Aligned to the DeeMarine Power BI source structure. Duplicate source rows are retained for traceability but excluded from visible metrics and weekly totals.</p></div></div>
      <div class="grid2">
        <div class="card"><h3>Source Structure</h3><p class="hint">Each intelligence record contains region, country, port/location, organization, category, development, key data/detail, operational significance, DeeMarine analysis angle, source, URL, source quality, status, impact, risk signal, opportunity signal, strategic impact and priority.</p></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>Weekly Edition Model</h3><p class="hint">Monday starts the edition. Tuesday–Friday append verified intelligence. Saturday consolidates and deduplicates the weekly dataset. Source rows flagged Duplicate remain traceable in the fact table but are excluded from website metrics and weekly totals. Sunday remains the final day. The same analytical layer feeds Power BI and the website.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card" style="margin-top:14px"><h3>Signal Logic</h3><div class="note"><b>Risk</b> = operational/commercial exposure • <b>Opportunity</b> = growth/efficiency/investment potential • <b>Risk + Opportunity</b> = both are material • <b>Watch</b> = emerging/low-confidence signal.</div></div>
    </section>

const REGION_OPTIONS = ["Canada", "Europe", "United States", "West Africa", "Global / Cross-Regional"];
const CATEGORY_OPTIONS = ["Digitalization & AI", "Energy Transition", "Energy & Fuel Supply Security", "Port Development & Infrastructure", "Safety & Security", "Trade & Logistics"];

const editionSelect = document.getElementById('edition');
const regionSelect = document.getElementById('region');
const categorySelect = document.getElementById('category');
const impactSelect = document.getElementById('impact');
const EDITION_OPTIONS = [...new Set(DATA.map(d=>d.edition).filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b, undefined, {numeric:true}));
EDITION_OPTIONS.forEach(v=>{let o=document.createElement('option');o.textContent=v;o.value=v;editionSelect.appendChild(o)});
REGION_OPTIONS.forEach(v=>{let o=document.createElement('option');o.textContent=v;o.value=v;regionSelect.appendChild(o)});
CATEGORY_OPTIONS.forEach(v=>{let o=document.createElement('option');o.textContent=v;o.value=v;categorySelect.appendChild(o)});
editionSelect.value = EDITION_OPTIONS[EDITION_OPTIONS.length - 1] || 'All Editions';

function filtered(){
  return DATA.filter(d => d.dup !== 'Duplicate' &&
    (editionSelect.value==='All Editions' || d.edition===editionSelect.value) &&
    (regionSelect.value==='All Regions' || d.region===regionSelect.value) &&
    (categorySelect.value==='All Categories' || d.category===categorySelect.value) &&
    (impactSelect.value==='All Impact' || d.impact===impactSelect.value)
  );
}
function selectedEditionLabel(){
  return editionSelect.value==='All Editions' ? 'All Editions' : editionSelect.value;
}
function updateEditionHeader(d){
  const dates=d.map(x=>x.published).filter(Boolean).sort();
  const latest=dates.length?dates[dates.length-1]:'';
  const subtitle=document.querySelector('.subtitle');
  if(subtitle) subtitle.textContent=`NEWS → DATA → SIGNAL → IMPACT → INSIGHT → DECISION • ${selectedEditionLabel()} • Latest report date: ${latest || '—'}`;
  const badge=document.getElementById('recordBadge');
  if(badge) badge.textContent=`${d.length} ${selectedEditionLabel()} records`.replace('All Editions records', 'records');
}
function counts(arr,key){const m={};arr.forEach(d=>m[d[key]]=(m[d[key]]||0)+1);return Object.entries(m).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);}
function barHTML(items, cls=''){const max=Math.max(1,...items.map(x=>x[1]));return items.map(([k,v])=>`<div class="barrow"><div>${k}</div><div class="bar"><div class="fill ${cls}" style="width:${(v/max*100).toFixed(1)}%"></div></div><b>${v}</b></div>`).join('');}
function signalClass(s){return s==='Risk'?'risk':s==='Opportunity'?'opp':s==='Risk + Opportunity'?'mix':'watch';}
function fmtScore(v){return Number(v).toFixed(1)}
function table(rows, cells){return `<table><thead><tr>${cells.map(c=>`<th>${c[0]}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(d=>`<tr>${cells.map(c=>{
  let v=d[c[1]];
  if(c[1]==='signal') v=`<span class="signal ${signalClass(d.signal)}">${d.signal}</span>`;
  if(c[1]==='priority'||c[1]==='strategic') v=fmtScore(v);
  if(c[1]==='url') v=`<a href="${d.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open source ↗</a>`;
  if(c[0]==='Organization / Development') v=`<b>${d.organization}</b><br><span style="color:#5a7085">${d.development}</span>`;
  if(c[1]==='priority' && cells.some(x=>x[1]==='development')) v=`<button style="background:none;border:0;color:var(--cyan2);cursor:pointer;font-weight:700" onclick="openDetailById('${encodeURIComponent(d.event_id||d.development)}')">${fmtScore(d.priority)}</button>`;
  return `<td>${v ?? ''}</td>`;
}).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`;}

const DATA_BY_ID = {};
DATA.forEach((d,i)=>{d._id='e'+i;DATA_BY_ID[d._id]=d;});
function openDetailById(id){
  const d=DATA_BY_ID[id] || DATA.find(x=>encodeURIComponent(x.development)===id); if(d) openDetail(d);
}
function openDetail(d){
  document.getElementById('detailPanel').innerHTML=`<div class="detail"><div class="detailbox"><h4>Development</h4><p>${d.development}</p><div class="detail-meta"><div class="meta"><small>Region / Country</small><b>${d.region} • ${d.country}</b></div><div class="meta"><small>Port / Location</small><b>${d.location}</b></div><div class="meta"><small>Category</small><b>${d.category}</b></div><div class="meta"><small>Organization</small><b>${d.organization}</b></div></div></div><div class="detailbox"><h4>DeeMarine Intelligence</h4><p><b>Why it matters:</b> ${d.why}</p><p style="margin-top:8px"><b>Analysis angle:</b> ${d.insight}</p><div class="detail-meta"><div class="meta"><small>Impact</small><b>${d.impact}</b></div><div class="meta"><small>Signal</small><b>${d.signal}</b></div><div class="meta"><small>Risk / Opportunity</small><b>${d.risk} / ${d.opportunity}</b></div><div class="meta"><small>Strategic Impact</small><b>${fmtScore(d.strategic)}</b></div><div class="meta"><small>Priority</small><b>${fmtScore(d.priority)}</b></div><div class="meta"><small>Source Quality</small><b>${d.source_quality}</b></div><div class="meta"><small>Status</small><b>${d.status}</b></div></div><p style="margin-top:10px"><a href="${d.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open source: ${d.source}</a></p></div></div>`;
}
function refresh(){
  const d=filtered();
  updateEditionHeader(d);
  const total=d.length, high=d.filter(x=>x.impact==='High').length, verified=d.filter(x=>x.status==='Verified').length;
  const strategic=total?d.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.strategic,0)/total:0, risk=d.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.risk,0), opp=d.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.opportunity,0);
  const regions=[...new Set(d.map(x=>x.region).filter(Boolean))].length;
  const wa=d.filter(x=>x.region==='West Africa').length;
  const verifiedPct=total?(verified/total*100):0;
  const waPct=total?(wa/total*100):0;
  document.getElementById('kpis').innerHTML=[
    ['Developments Tracked',total,'Weekly intelligence records'],
    ['Regions Covered',regions,'Canada • U.S. • Europe • West Africa'],
    ['Verified Intelligence',verifiedPct.toFixed(1)+'%',verified+' of '+total+' verified'],
    ['West Africa Share',waPct.toFixed(1)+'%',wa+' developments']
  ].map(k=>`<div class="kpi"><div class="label">${k[0]}</div><div class="value">${k[1]}</div><div class="sub">${k[2]}</div></div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('regionBars').innerHTML=barHTML(counts(d,'region'));
  document.getElementById('impactBars').innerHTML=barHTML(counts(d,'impact'),'mix');
  document.getElementById('categoryBars').innerHTML=barHTML(counts(d,'category'));
  const top=[...d].sort((a,b)=>b.priority-a.priority).slice(0,7);
  const top5=top.slice(0,5);
  document.getElementById('topEvents').innerHTML=top5.map((e,i)=>`<div class="top5-item"><div class="top5-rank">${i+1}</div><div><div class="top5-title">${e.organization}</div><div class="top5-meta">${e.development}</div><span class="top5-pill">${e.category}</span></div><div class="top5-side">${e.region}<br>${e.published}</div></div>`).join('');
  const verifiedRows=d.filter(x=>x.status==='Verified').sort((a,b)=>String(b.published).localeCompare(String(a.published)));
  const allVerified=document.getElementById('allVerified');
  if(allVerified) allVerified.innerHTML=table(verifiedRows,[['Date','published'],['Region','region'],['Organization / Development','organization'],['Category','category'],['Impact','impact'],['Source','url']]);
  const iv=document.querySelector('#allVerifiedCard h3'); if(iv) iv.firstChild.nodeValue=`Verified Developments (${verifiedRows.length})`;
  document.getElementById('riskTable').innerHTML=table(top,[['Development','development'],['Impact','impact'],['Signal','signal'],['Priority','priority']]);
  document.getElementById('briefTable').innerHTML=table(top.slice(0,5),[['Rank','priority'],['Region','region'],['Development','development'],['Signal','signal'],['Priority','priority']]);
  const lead=top[0];
  const ih=document.getElementById('insightHeadline'), ib=document.getElementById('insightBody');
  if(ih) ih.textContent=lead ? (lead.signal==='Risk' ? 'Risk is rising where operations and policy intersect.' : lead.signal==='Opportunity' ? 'The strongest opportunity is where infrastructure meets execution.' : 'Infrastructure alone is no longer enough.') : 'What is the signal behind the headlines?';
  if(ib) ib.textContent=lead ? `${lead.why} ${lead.insight}` : 'The weekly dataset is converted into a management-level interpretation of what changed, why it matters and what should be watched next.';
  document.getElementById('whatChanged').textContent=lead?lead.development:'No matching intelligence record.';
  document.getElementById('whyMatters').textContent=lead?lead.why:'Adjust the filters to inspect the dataset.';
  document.getElementById('watchNext').textContent=lead?lead.insight:'Use the risk and opportunity filters to identify emerging signals.';
  if(lead) openDetail(lead);

  const portKeywords=['port','terminal','dredg','shore power','cold-ironing','gateway','harbour','harbor'];
  const isPortRecord=x=>{
    const cat=String(x.category||'').toLowerCase();
    const original=String(x.original_category||'').toLowerCase();
    const locOrg=(String(x.location||'')+' '+String(x.organization||'')).toLowerCase();
    const explicit=cat==='port development & infrastructure';
    const sourceTaxonomy=portKeywords.some(k=>original.includes(k));
    const physicalAsset=portKeywords.some(k=>locOrg.includes(k));
    return explicit || sourceTaxonomy || physicalAsset;
  };
  const ports=d.filter(isPortRecord);
  const portHigh=ports.filter(x=>x.impact==='High').length;
  const portRisk=ports.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.risk||0),0);
  const portOpp=ports.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.opportunity||0),0);
  const portAvgPriority=ports.length?ports.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.priority||0),0)/ports.length:0;
  document.getElementById('portKpis').innerHTML=[
    ['PORT / INFRA RECORDS',ports.length,'Explicit port + port-specific infrastructure signals'],
    ['HIGH-IMPACT PORT EVENTS',portHigh,'High-impact developments in the selected edition'],
    ['RISK / OPPORTUNITY',`${portRisk.toFixed(0)} / ${portOpp.toFixed(0)}`,'Aggregate port-sector signals'],
    ['AVG PRIORITY',fmtScore(portAvgPriority),'Average priority score for port records']
  ].map(k=>`<div class="kpi"><div class="label">${k[0]}</div><div class="value">${k[1]}</div><div class="sub">${k[2]}</div></div>`).join('');

  const portSourceMsg = ports.length
    ? `<b>${ports.length} port-related records identified.</b> The page now includes explicit Port Development & Infrastructure records plus relevant port, terminal, dredging, gateway and infrastructure signals held under Trade & Logistics or other categories.`
    : `<b>No port-related records match the current filters.</b> Try All Categories / All Impact or select another Edition.`;
  document.getElementById('portInsightNote').innerHTML=portSourceMsg;

  document.getElementById('portBars').innerHTML=barHTML(counts(ports,'region'),'opp');
  document.getElementById('portSignalBars').innerHTML=barHTML(counts(ports,'signal'),'mix');
  document.getElementById('portLocationBars').innerHTML=barHTML(counts(ports,'location'),'opp');

  const portThemeCounts={
    'Capacity / Expansion':0,
    'Dredging / Marine Access':0,
    'Decarbonisation / Shore Power':0,
    'Gateway / Regional Competitiveness':0,
    'Port Efficiency / Logistics':0,
    'Governance / Regulation':0
  };
  ports.forEach(x=>{
    const t=String(x.original_category||'').toLowerCase()+' '+String(x.development||'').toLowerCase()+' '+String(x.insight||'').toLowerCase();
    if(/shore power|cold-ironing|decarbon|green fuel|emission/.test(t)) portThemeCounts['Decarbonisation / Shore Power']++;
    if(/dredg|draft|deep-sea|channel|berth/.test(t)) portThemeCounts['Dredging / Marine Access']++;
    if(/capacity|terminal|expansion|development/.test(t)) portThemeCounts['Capacity / Expansion']++;
    if(/hub|gateway|competit|regional/.test(t)) portThemeCounts['Gateway / Regional Competitiveness']++;
    if(/export|logistics|throughput|cargo|bottleneck|efficien/.test(t)) portThemeCounts['Port Efficiency / Logistics']++;
    if(/governance|authority|regulatory|reform/.test(t)) portThemeCounts['Governance / Regulation']++;
  });
  document.getElementById('portThemeBars').innerHTML=barHTML(Object.entries(portThemeCounts).filter(x=>x[1]>0),'opp');

  const portTop=[...ports].sort((a,b)=>b.priority-a.priority).slice(0,8);
  document.getElementById('portTable').innerHTML=ports.length ? table(portTop,[['Location','location'],['Organization / Development','organization'],['Impact','impact'],['Signal','signal'],['Priority','priority'],['Source','url']]) : '<div class="note">No matching port intelligence records.</div>';
  const portRows=[...ports].sort((a,b)=>String(b.published).localeCompare(String(a.published)) || b.priority-a.priority);
  document.getElementById('portDatasetTable').innerHTML=portRows.length ? table(portRows,[['Date','published'],['Region','region'],['Country','country'],['Port / Location','location'],['Category','category'],['Original Category','original_category'],['Development','development'],['Operational Relevance','why'],['Impact','impact'],['Risk','risk'],['Opportunity','opportunity'],['Priority','priority'],['Source','url']]) : '<div class="note">No matching port intelligence records.</div>';

  const trade=d.filter(x=>x.category==='Trade & Logistics');
  document.getElementById('tradeBars').innerHTML=barHTML(counts(trade,'region'),'risk');
  document.getElementById('tradeTable').innerHTML=table(trade,[['Region','region'],['Location','location'],['Development','development'],['Priority','priority']]);

  const energy=d.filter(x=>x.category==='Energy Transition'), digital=d.filter(x=>x.category==='Digitalisation'), security=d.filter(x=>x.category==='Safety & Security');
  document.getElementById('energyPanel').innerHTML=`<b>${energy.length}</b> events<br><span class="hint">Port decarbonisation, shore power, alternative fuels and infrastructure readiness.</span>`;
  document.getElementById('digitalPanel').innerHTML=`<b>${digital.length}</b> events<br><span class="hint">Digital registry, maritime data, automation and process visibility.</span>`;
  document.getElementById('securityPanel').innerHTML=`<b>${security.length}</b> events<br><span class="hint">Vessel security, chokepoints, incidents and emergency readiness.</span>`;
  document.getElementById('themeBars').innerHTML=barHTML([['Energy Transition',energy.length],['Digitalisation',digital.length],['Safety & Security',security.length]]);

  const canvas=document.getElementById('mapCanvas');
  canvas.querySelectorAll('.port').forEach(x=>x.remove());
  const eventCoords={
    'Corner Brook, Newfoundland and Labrador':[-57.95,48.95],
    'Canadian commercial fishing waters':[-48.5,48.0],
    'Valderhaugfjorden near Alesund':[6.15,62.47],
    'EU TEN-T maritime corridors':[16.0,50.0],
    'Gioia Tauro':[15.9,38.45],

    'U.S.-Israel liner trade':[18.0,35.2],
    'U.S.–South Korea trade route':[154.0,31.0],
    'Ogun State / Ogun Deep Sea Port':[3.45,6.35],
    'Nigerian Ship Registry, Lagos':[3.38,6.48],
    'Kingston, Ontario':[-76.48,44.23],
    'TEN-T maritime corridors':[11.5,54.0],
    'Black Sea':[30.2,43.5],
    'Strait of Hormuz':[56.4,26.6],

    'Tema Port, Ghana':[-0.20,5.62],

    'South African ports':[31.0,-29.90]
  };
  const fallbackCoords={'Canada':[-105,58],'Norway':[10,62],'European Union':[15,50],'European maritime trade':[10,45],'Italy':[12.5,42.5],'Romania / Ukraine':[29,46],'United States':[-95,38],'United States / Israel':[10,35],'United States / South Korea':[145,30],'Ghana':[-1.2,7.9],'Nigeria':[7.7,9.5],'South Africa':[24,-30.6]};
  const proj=(lon,lat)=>({left:((lon+180)/360*100),top:((85-lat)/(145)*100)});
  d.forEach((e,i)=>{let c=eventCoords[e.location]||fallbackCoords[e.country]||[0,0];let p=proj(c[0],c[1]);let dot=document.createElement('button');dot.type='button';dot.className='port';let size=10+Math.min(10,(e.priority||3)*1.0);dot.style.width=size+'px';dot.style.height=size+'px';dot.style.left=p.left+'%';dot.style.top=p.top+'%';dot.style.background=e.signal==='Risk'?'var(--red)':e.signal==='Opportunity'?'var(--green)':e.signal==='Risk + Opportunity'?'var(--amber)':'var(--blue)';dot.setAttribute('aria-label',e.country+' • '+e.location+' • '+e.development);dot.title=e.country+' • '+e.location+' • Priority '+fmtScore(e.priority)+' • '+e.signal;dot.addEventListener('click',()=>{canvas.querySelectorAll('.port.selected').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));dot.classList.add('selected');openDetail(e)});canvas.appendChild(dot)});
  const radar=document.getElementById('radarCanvas');radar.querySelectorAll('.dot').forEach(x=>x.remove());
  d.forEach(e=>{let dot=document.createElement('div');dot.className='dot';dot.style.left=(8+(e.opportunity/5)*84)+'%';dot.style.top=(92-(e.risk/5)*84)+'%';dot.style.background=e.signal==='Risk'?'var(--red)':e.signal==='Opportunity'?'var(--green)':e.signal==='Risk + Opportunity'?'var(--amber)':'var(--blue)';dot.title=e.development;radar.appendChild(dot)});
}

document.querySelectorAll('.nav button').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.nav button').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));btn.classList.add('active');document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));document.getElementById(btn.dataset.page).classList.add('active')}));
[editionSelect,regionSelect,categorySelect,impactSelect].forEach(x=>x.addEventListener('change',refresh));
refresh();
</script>
</body>
</html>
